data.action: 靠着灯柱，百无聊赖地踢石子
data.description: 【能天使 · 华灯初上】夜幕降临的龙门街头路灯下，能天使背靠着冰凉的金属灯柱，百无聊赖地用鞋尖踢着路边的小石子，头顶的光环随着微风忽明忽暗。看到迎面走来的你，她两眼瞬间亮起——「太慢啦老板！我都在这里等了你整整十五分钟了，待会儿必须罚你请我吃两份苹果派！」
data.promptProse: Exusiai waits against a metal lamppost on the Lungmen street as evening becomes night, nudging a small roadside stone with her boot. Her tactical layers and messenger bag remain in the medium frame. Lanterns and neon signs run down the market street behind her; their warm and cool reflections stripe the pole while her halo flickers above a suddenly bright, welcoming expression.
data.title: 能天使 · 华灯初上
